name: Cankerous Thirst — {B} spent and {G} spent are separate toggles with separate targets
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-06). "If {B} was spent to cast this spell, you may have target creature get -3/-3 until end of turn. If {G} was spent to cast this spell, you may have target creature get +3/+3 until end of turn." A spell had one cast-condition toggle, so a card with two different conditions was left alone: the first sentence gave every creature -3/-3 unconditionally and the second did nothing. The spell now has a second toggle (additionalCostLabel2 / additionalCostPaid2, condition "[additional cost 2 paid]") and each sentence is its own target slot. First copy, only {G} spent: Hill Giant (the -3/-3 target) stays 3/3, Grizzly Bears (the +3/+3 target) is 5/5. Second copy, only {B} spent, both targets Gray Ogre: 2/2 becomes -1/-1, not 2/2.
